name: Miyakuni Ichigo
source: [url=/c22753]Mayu's[/url] neighbor and childhood friend and also the president of the literary club. He is hardworking boy who rarely gives up and can also read the mood quite skillfully, but he isn't all that invested in finding a girlfriend. Because he has taken care of Mayu ever since they were young, Ichigo is quite proficient at all kinds of household chores and can also understand what girls generally like.
